error.missingIssueToken: The issue token is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badIssueToken: That does not look like a Nest issue token. It should start with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc and contain login_hint.
error.missingCookie: The cookie is missing. Copy it from your browser as described in the app settings.
error.badCookie: That cookie has no __Secure-3PSID value, which is the one the session depends on.
error.notConfigured: Add your issue token and cookie in the app settings first.
error.noDevices: No Nest Protect devices were found on this account.
error.deviceGone: This device is no longer on the Nest account.

settings.title: Nest Protect
settings.intro: This app signs in the way the Nest app itself does, because Google's supported API does not cover Nest Protect at all.
settings.warning: The cookie is a full Google account session credential, not a Nest-only token. Keep it out of screenshots and bug reports.
